central_problem: 搜尋候選、使用者接受、Evidence Card 與 report generation 的責任如何接起來？
reader_takeaway: 一條單向 source-first flow 比一個更強的 prompt 更能降低錯誤穿透。

known_at_the_time.fact: 6/16–6/18 commits 增加 source cards、accepted source digest、evidence cards、accepted synthesis 與 generation readiness。
6/18 architecture audit 記錄 topic → search → review → accepted sources → evidence cards → draft → preview → export。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: report generation 的輸入被限定為 accepted source/evidence flow，而不是全部 raw search results。

not_yet_available.fact: 當時仍沒有 later canonical admission owner；accepted source 與 evidence card 不是 FORMAL authorization。

observed_failures.symptom: workflow 已分階段，但 authority 仍散落於 UI state 與 helper modules。
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: canonical owner had not yet been designed
observed_failures.what_was_known_then: accepted sources 應先於 report draft。
observed_failures.later_resolution: 2026-08-28 current worktree introduced a canonical admission owner; this is hindsight.

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: The 6/18 architecture snapshot names eight workflow stages from topic through export.
tests_and_metrics.result: workflow shape verified; not an acceptance score

engineering_decisions.decision: 先讓人審查與接受來源，再由 evidence layer 產生可追蹤材料。

architecture_state.state: topic → search plan → source review → accepted sources → evidence cards → draft → preview → export

safe_numbers.meaning: the 6/18 documented flow stages, not an acceptance score

safe_public_facts.fact: 接受來源才是早期 report workflow 的下游輸入；這是一個流程邊界，不是成熟真值系統。

retrospective_notes.note: 後來的 canonical admission 不是推翻 source-first 順序，而是把每一關的權限與 revision 收斂起來。

source_refs.why_it_supports_this_fact: backend evidence card builder exists later in the committed period

publication_risks: 不要寫成 6 月已有 canonical authority。
不要將 accepted source 數量當成 evidence sufficiency。
